entries.description: Read required guidance, reviewed the pdf-newpage-multipage-fix-consumption spec, confirmed the sibling DabblerPdf change-log prerequisite, and initialized the session log.
Routed a focused analysis prompt to validate the safest page-count assertion strategy for the new PdfPig-based Playwright coverage.
Updated central package management to consume DabblerPdf 1.1.1 and added the test-only PdfPig dependency for the caller-level and Playwright test projects.
Replaced the caller-level byte-grep title check with PdfPig per-physical-page assertions and added a logical-pages-versus-physical-pages count check for a multi-page export.

Upgraded the Orders by Retail Business Playwright PDF export coverage to inspect the downloaded PDF bytes with PdfPig and compare page-1 text plus physical page count against the composed report state.

Validation results: dotnet build Dabbler.Platform.sln passed; dotnet test Dabbler.Platform.sln --filter FullyQualifiedName~PdfExport passed; targeted CallerLevelPdfExportTests passed; targeted OrdersByCustomer_PdfExport_DownloadMatchesRenderedPageCountAsync passed with PLAYWRIGHT_BASE_URL=http://localhost:5020 and PLAYWRIGHT_API_BASE_URL=http://localhost:5021; dotnet test Dabbler.Platform.sln and dotnet test tests/AcmeCoffeeOnline.Playwright/AcmeCoffeeOnline.Playwright.csproj both failed only on the pre-existing Playwright test SecurityDashboardUatFollowupCoverageTests.SecurityNav_BakedInUserPersona_RealLoginFlow_NavVisibleRoleDocOnlyAsync waiting for an Admin button.
Ran mandatory cross-provider session verification against the implementation and validation evidence for Session 1.
Generated the session-set change log through the router using summarization at max_tier=1, including the Finding 2 correction narrative.
